issues.description: The problem statement text incorrectly specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML diagram, the template hint, and the solution all use addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch between the textual instruction and the UML/code can confuse students about the expected parameter type and what they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML diagram, the template comments, and the intended solution. Ensure the textual task description consistently refers to the integer parameter (number of new guest students).

issues.description: The problem statement (text) specifies a method addGuestStudents(String) while the UML in the same problem statement and the solution implementation define addGuestStudents(int). This inconsistent method signature (parameter type) for the same conceptual operation can confuse students about the expected API and whether they should accept a String or an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md text to declare addGuestStudents(int) (matching the UML and solution) or, if a String is intended, update the UML, template TODO, and solution to use addGuestStudents(String) and document the expected parsing behavior. Prefer using addGuestStudents(int) for clarity and to match the current UML and solution.
